server.description: Top-level server configuration for mDNS/DNS-SD behavior and publishing

use_ipv4.description: Enable IPv4 support for mDNS/DNS-SD. Disable only on IPv6-only systems.

use_ipv6.description: Enable IPv6 support for mDNS/DNS-SD. Disable only on IPv4-only systems.

publish_hinfo.description: Publish host information (CPU/OS) via HINFO records.

publish_workstation.description: Publish the workstation service (used by some legacy clients).

publish_domain.description: Default domain to advertise (usually 'local' for mDNS).

publish_resolved.description: Advertise that the local resolver supports DNS-SD via unicast.

rr_ttl.description: Time-to-live (TTL) in seconds for published DNS records.

host_name.description: Optional custom host name to advertise. If empty, system hostname is used.

reflector.description: Configuration for mDNS reflection between network segments

enabled.description: Enable mDNS reflector mode to forward mDNS queries/responses across subnets.

network_namespace.description: Enable reflection across Linux network namespaces (requires systemd >= v248).

wide_area.description: Configuration for Wide Area mDNS (for non-local domains, rarely used)

enabled.description: Enable wide-area (non-local) DNS-SD discovery. Requires special infrastructure.
Enable Lua scripting in the daemon (advanced users only).

directory.description: Directory containing Lua scripts and service definitions.

watch_config.description: Automatically reload configuration when the file changes.

system_pub_sub.description: Allow D-Bus clients to publish and subscribe to services via the system bus.

rate_limiting.description: Rate limiting to prevent abuse/mDNS storms

enabled.description: Enable rate limiting for incoming mDNS packets.

interval_sec.description: Time window (in seconds) for counting packets.

max_packets.description: Maximum packets allowed per interval before throttling.

publish_services.description: List of additional custom services to publish (beyond automatic discovery)

type.description: Service type (e.g., '_http._tcp') or omit to auto-detect

publish_domains.description: List of domains to announce (in addition to the default 'local' domain)
